أَبُو جِعْرَانَ [in which the latter word is imperfectly decl. because it is a proper name ending with the augment ان] The [black beetle called] جُعَل, (Kr, K, TA,) in a general sense: or, as some say, a certain species thereof. (TA.) ―
-b2- And أُمُّ جِعْرَانَ, (K, TA,) or أُمُّ جِعْرَانَةَ, (so in a copy of the K,) The رَخَمَة [or female of the vultur percnopterus]. (Kr, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
